data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 泳池边银蓝比基尼的修长微倚
data.description: 盛夏度假酒店泳池畔，罗丝薇瑟身穿银蓝色细带比基尼微倚在躺椅扶手上，高挑的身材与饱满曲线在水光波纹下无比耀眼。
data.location: 豪华度假酒店无边际泳池边
data.action: 侧身倚在池畔躺椅旁，银色长发垂落胸前，单手轻拨遮阳墨镜，略带知性害羞地轻笑
data.lighting: 波光粼粼的水面反射在雪白肌肤上，形成律动微光
data.camera: 全身侧角机位，完美衬托九头身完美女武神体态
data.promptProse: Rossweisse pauses gracefully alongside a sun lounger beside an infinity pool overlooking the ocean at a premier summer resort. Wearing a sleek metallic silver-blue string bikini that showcases her tall, sculpted Valkyrie proportions, water caustics dance across her fair skin. Pushing down her designer sunglasses with one slender finger, she offers a poised, slightly self-conscious smile under the radiant sun.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against the infinity pool lounger in her shimmering silver-blue bikini, Rossweisse adjusts her sunglasses with mature grace.
